card.text: Kepler-409 b was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Kepler-409b"
sources.quote: Kepler-409b is a super-Earth orbiting Kepler-409, a G-type main-sequence star.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Kepler-409. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
